title: AudiToad evaluator file
description: Names the models an operator uses and how each question role named by a baseline uses them. Baselines never name models; swap models or change how they cooperate by editing this file.

evaluators.description: Named models. Without roles, each name is also a role; rules without a role use the role named default.

backend.description: The request and response protocol. typesafe-jev speaks TypeSafe's question API. openai-compatible uses chat completions with first-token log-probabilities (llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM or a hosted API); it answers choice/1 questions of up to 26 options.

allow_images.description: Explicit typesafe-jev opt-in to the image preview header. Omitted/false preserves ordinary text bindings. This policy participates in evaluator/reuse identity.

response_model.description: openai-compatible only. Exact expected response model identifier when the request uses an alias. Defaults to model. The response must name it; this decoding policy participates in evaluator and reuse identity.

capabilities.description: Optional explicit supported tasks. Omitted means the backend's installed tasks. Cannot enable a task the backend lacks; policy is retained in evaluator and reuse identities.

max_output_tokens.description: Largest generated answer for an extract/1 task. Default 2048.

max_request_bytes.description: Largest request this endpoint accepts. Requests are also bounded by the scan limit and the question's own limit.

max_provider_calls.description: Per-run call ceiling for this model across all its roles. Zero disables calls. CLI --max-provider-calls overrides it and also caps the entire scan.

max_evidence_bytes.description: Per-run request bytes plus reserved response bytes for this model. Zero refuses requests. CLI --max-evidence-bytes overrides it and also caps all scan evidence.

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for one provider exchange, default 30. CLI --provider-timeout-seconds overrides it.

choice_probability_sum_tolerance.description: typesafe-jev only. Absolute tolerance around a Choice probability sum of 1; default 0.000001. An explicit value up to 0.01 can admit rounded distributions. Raw probabilities are retained without normalization; a nondefault policy changes evaluator identity.

endpoint.description: Full request URL. https, or http on a loopback host.

key.description: Where the API key comes from. Omit for a keyless local server.

roles.description: How each question role uses the named models: use one, ask several and combine their answers, or switch the role off so its questions are not asked.

combine.description: first_resolved asks in order and stops at the first pass or fail answer; agreement needs every model to give the same pass or fail answer; any_fail fails on any fail answer; all_fail fails only when every answer fails.
